meta.source: London Datastore: Average House Prices by Borough, Ward, MSOA & LSOA (HM Land Registry)
meta.attribution: Contains public sector information licensed under the Open Government Licence v3 (HM Land Registry). The GLA cannot warrant the quality or accuracy of the data (London Datastore terms).
meta.method: lds-harvest-auto.mjs run 2jkxd: resources chosen by the written rules; every row of every sheet or CSV read (CSV over 20 MB streamed and not stored; large xlsx streamed with ExcelJS); a row is kept when it is a zone row (harvest-log.json meta.rules.zone_row): zone OA/LSOA/MSOA/ward code, zone postcode or postcode sector, zone UPRN or TOID, or coordinates in the 3D model box. zone_keys gives the key that matched, row by row. header_rows: the rows above the first data row.
selection_notes: hand rule: the workbooks (one row per area, years across); the CSVs (89 MB for LSOA) hold the same figures one row per area and year
